description.title: ביטוח יצירות אמנות
description.summary: This table details the conditions for insuring fine art collections. It outlines how losses are calculated, especially for items that are part of a pair or set, and the insurer's rights after a payout.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח לאספני אמנות מכסה נזק או אובדן של יצירות אמנות, כאשר סכום הפיצוי מחושב בהתאם לשווי שסוכם מראש עבור פריטים ספציפיים. במקרה של אובדן חלקי, הפיצוי יכסה את עלות התיקון בתוספת ירידת הערך, אך לא יעלה על השווי המקורי של הפריט. במקרה של תשלום מלא עבור פריט, הזכויות עוברות למבטח.
description.row_axis: Specific conditions related to loss or damage
description.column_axis: Details of how the insurance applies in different scenarios (pairs/sets, partial loss, full payout)
notable_values: Pairs/Sets: Proportional value of the set is paid
Partial Loss: Cost of restoration + depreciation
Agreed Value: Used for individually listed items
Market Value: Used for items not individually listed

sketch:
10.3  Pairs and Sets In event of loss or damage to any item or items having a special or increased value by virtue of forming part of a pair or set, this insurance shall not take account of any such special or increased value, but shall only pay a proportionate part of the insured value of such pair or set.
Nevertheless in no event will the Insurer be liable for more than the applicable limits of liability set out in the Schedule.
In the event of partial loss of or damage to any item insured the amount payable will be the cost and expense of restoration plus any resulting depreciation but not exceeding the full value of that item, valued as in the schedule.
Following payment of the full amount insured for any item, pair or set, the Insurer will become the full owners and reserve the right to take possession of the item, pair or set.

טבלה: ביטוח יצירות אמנות
This table details the conditions for insuring fine art collections. It outlines how losses are calculated, especially for items that are part of a pair or set, and the insurer's rights after a payout.

10.3  Pairs and Sets In event of loss or damage to any item or items having a special or increased value by virtue of forming part of a pair or set, this insurance shall not take account of any such special or increased value, but shall only pay a proportionate part of the insured value of such pair or set.
Nevertheless in no event will the Insurer be liable for more than the applicable limits of liability set out in the Schedule.
In the event of partial loss of or damage to any item insured the amount payable will be the cost and expense of restoration plus any resulting depreciation but not exceeding the full value of that item, valued as in the schedule.
Following payment of the full amount insured for any item, pair or set, the Insurer will become the full owners and reserve the right to take possession of the item, pair or set.
